items.title: What is eBay’s (EBAY) Economic Moat, and is it Widening or Narrowing?
items.summary: eBay Inc. (NASDAQ:EBAY) closed at $106.05 on September 30, more than 16% higher than a year ago. The company is worth roughly $48.5 billion, turns 21.57% of its $12.01 billion in revenue into operating profit, and returns 46.61% on equity. Those are not the numbers of a business Amazon destroyed, which is the assumption most […]

items.title: Is eBay Stock Priced Right Against Its Peers?
items.summary: eBay (EBAY) turns more of its sales into operating profit than Amazon, Walmart, MercadoLibre, Etsy or Target. Yet you pay less for each dollar of eBay's profit than for Walmart's or MercadoLibre's. Is eBay stock discounted against those two for a real worry, or simply priced below what it delivers.

items.title: Nvidia boosts stock buyback program, how AI will change the advertising landscape
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi shares his takes on the day's biggest market stories, including Nvidia's (NVDA) $150 billion extension to its stock buyback program and the state of Nike's turnaround strategy. Sozzi also sits down with Sir Martin Sorrell to discuss the impact AI will have on the advertising industry.

items.title: Is it time to sound the alarm on a Nike reset?
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi sounds the alarm on Nike (NKE), noting that its stock price repeatedly hits new 52-week lows and that CEO Elliott Hill's position could be at risk if the company doesn't innovate.

items.title: GameStop Tumbles 8% Despite Ryan Cohen’s $26M Insider Buy; eBay Ticks Up
